propositions: Documentation ownership policy must distinguish durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence without deterministic validation gates
Writing rules and Protected forms guidance must be restored as authoring guidance without adding character, word, punctuation, paragraph, or prose validators or enforcement gates
Generated and parity-gated artifact catalogs must be relocated to docs/generated-artifacts.md with lossless preservation of all inventory entries and consumer references
Policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md must describe the policy as a guidance source, not a deterministic gate
Eight documentation role categories must each define audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citations, correction method, exclusions, and examples
